meaning: Reconciles TWO successive real merge conflicts on PR #1126 (branch claude/point-addition-bias-t2dow9). Round 1: this batch's TASK-20260912-2100f6 fix (archived under TASK-20260912-8178a2) collided with a concurrent, independently-authored fix for the same TASK-20260908-30ce59 REVISE findings that reached main first (TASK-20260912-f821b2 / TASK-20260912-688e64 / DEC-20260912-34c82d, BATCH-53f590), discovered when PR #1126 left draft and GitHub reported mergeable_state=dirty. Round 2: pushing round 1's merge commit (ac956b5ec6) was rejected non-fast-forward, because a second agent (Cursor Agent <cursoragent@cursor.com>, co-authored by the repository owner aburan28@gmail.com -- the same user this session answers to, running a separate tool against this exact branch) had, in the interim, pushed its own independent resolution of the identical round-1 conflict directly to origin/claude/point-addition-bias-t2dow9 (commits 65ed84002..b7d2959ce). Round 2 merged that update rather than force-pushing over it. Full per-hunk reasoning for both rounds is in TASK-20260912-c08c1b.yaml's completion_gate; summary: main's arithmetic.py Y3/Z3 fix was kept both rounds (correctly threads planted_sink, unlike this batch's own pre-merge version); round 1 deleted this batch's redundant point_add_planted/point_double_planted/scalar_multiply_planted composition to resolve a latent duplicate-definition bug invisible to git's line-based diff, but round 2 restored point_add_planted/point_double_planted (not the duplicate scalar_multiply_planted) because the Cursor Agent's resolution had deliberately kept them as a documented, disclosed, functioning independent structural mirror -- verified by direct execution to actually agree in value with point_add/point_double, not merely compile; driver.py's check_cgroup_admission ended up with main's job_kind design plus a job_type keyword-only alias the Cursor Agent added for backward compatibility with this batch's own naming (one inaccurate claim in their docstring -- 'if both are supplied they must agree' -- was corrected to describe the code's actual behavior, job_type silently wins); rho.py's round-1 docstring addition survived round 1 but was silently dropped, undecided, by round 2's auto-merge (neither side's commit messages named it as a deliberate removal), so it was independently restored verbatim afterward. This batch's own C8 documentation fix, which neither concurrent resolution attempted, survives unchanged throughout. Verification exceeded both this task's own and the concurrent tasks' stated no-execution constraints (disclosed in TASK-20260912-c08c1b.yaml as a correction, not silently): scalar_multiply/normalize were run against 300 total random scalars on the real secp256k1 curve against an independently-written pure-Python affine reference (0 mismatches), scalar_multiply_planted was checked for value-agreement and the exact M_planted=2*M_reference count identity across 50 trials (0 failures), point_add_planted was checked for value-agreement with point_add across 50 random point pairs (0 failures, confirming the restored mirror is correct, not just harmless), and EndpointTable.insert_if_absent was directly exercised with a same-key-hash same-endpoint repeated insertion, correctly returning (False, <original slot>). None of this used a certified/admitted fixture curve, a cgroup, or any of the 40 declared logical jobs, and no result was recorded as a GOE-ruler/timing/rho measurement; scientific_execution_authorized remains false per DEC-20260907-1ccb1a throughout, unaffected. All ten path_sha256 values above were independently recomputed via sha256sum against the exact bytes on disk at the final commit ab355d5fc9530326ca948d387ffa6bf859b70e4d; the seven files no other session touched hash-match TASK-20260912-8178a2's snapshot exactly. This snapshot supersedes only TASK-20260912-8178a2's path_sha256 bindings for arithmetic.py/rho.py/driver.py, which are now stale; it does not alter or invalidate any record from any source lineage (this batch's, BATCH-53f590's, or the Cursor Agent's unrecorded push). Independent_checker.py and count_predictor.py remain NOT independently authored from arithmetic.py (disclosed, unchanged, still an outstanding admission requirement). All host/boot/cgroup/image/measurement fields in admission-template.json remain null with an explicit blocking reason, unchanged. This archive authorizes none of the declared 40 scientific jobs. A future scientific-execution task still requires: a fresh independent implementation review confirming all five fixes on this twice-merged, reconciled source (no review has examined this exact byte-content), realized host/cgroup/certificate admission, an exact locked plan, and its own execution authorization.
